title: Let’s repeat what we learned
intro: Subhanaka, Al-Fatiha, Allah, the Prophet (SAW), Hasbi Rabbi and the right side – let’s repeat!

learn.html: Let’s repeat! Say the missing word out loud with your muallim:

items: At the start of every Salah we recite ________. With these words we glorify and ________ Allah, the Most High.
Al-Fatiha is the first surah in the ________. We recite it in Salah. It starts with: Al-hamdu lillaahi ________.
Our Lord is ________. He is the Creator of everything that ________. He gives us a happy ________.
When we say Allah’s name we say ________, which means the Most High.
The last Messenger of Allah is ________ (SAW). He was born in the city of ________.
His parents, ________ and ________, died early. He grew up with his grandfather ________.
When he was ____ years old, Allah began to send him the revelation of the noble ________.
A Muslim relies only on ________ (Hasbi Rabbi).
Islam gives priority to the ________ side. We eat with the ________ hand.

questions.q: At the start of every Salah we recite…
Al-Fatiha is the first surah in the…

In which city was Muhammad (SAW) born?
